agents.name: ollama_agent
agents.instruction: Use the available tools to answer questions about which Ollama models are available locally. When you reply, name which tool(s) you used and what each one returned.

tools.name: ollama_list
tools.description:
Lists the names of Ollama models currently available on this machine.

Args:
    api_base: Base URL of the local Ollama server. Leave at the default
        unless Ollama is reachable somewhere else.

Returns:
    One model name (e.g. "gemma4:latest") per locally available model.

Raises:
    OllamaListError: If the Ollama API is unreachable or returns an
        unexpected response.

agents.name: system_card_agent
agents.instruction: Use the available tools to answer the user's request. When you reply, name which tool(s) you used and what each one returned.

tools.name: calculator
tools.description:
Performs a single basic arithmetic operation on two numbers.

Args:
    a: The first operand.
    b: The second operand.
    operator: One of "+", "-", "*", "/".

Returns:
    The result of applying the operator to a and b.

Raises:
    DivisionByZeroError: If operator is "/" and b is zero.

tools.name: coin_flip
tools.description:
Flips a fair coin.

Returns:
    Either "heads" or "tails", each with equal probability.

tools.name: dad_joke
tools.description:
Returns a random, groan-worthy dad joke from a fixed list.

Returns:
    A single joke as a plain string.

tools.name: shakespearify
tools.description:
Rewrites text with mock-Shakespearean word substitutions.

Args:
    text: The input text to rewrite.

Returns:
    The text with common words swapped for archaic equivalents,
    case-insensitively, preserving the original capitalisation style.

tools.name: word_count
tools.description:
Counts the number of whitespace-separated words in text.

Args:
    text: The input text to count words in.

Returns:
    The number of words found. An empty or whitespace-only string returns 0.
